reviews.text: They do an excellent job with my dog no disappointment at all. There super friendly as well. 10/10
Good prices and amazing job done with my dog very satisfied :]
I had been coming here for years! Great experience, my babies always looking good

Please be careful where you take your beloved pets I loved and trusted this place I have recommended them to a lot of people.I never thought they would do something like this
Took bella perfectly fine a happy 4 yr old dog and they give me a sad, scared shivering dog she peed in my car and on my bed
I had to take her to the vet because her eye kept getting worse I try to communicate with them and they don’t want to say what happened or at least apologize,I sent them the vet bill and told them it’s up to you if you want to help me with the bill because the vet said in fact they did something to her that caused this, bella is 4 years old and never had this happen before!
The person who text me said they don’t service Rottweilers but then I clearly see a Rottweiler on there page this place is a joke when they claim to be groomers
BEST GROOMER IN TOWN HANDS DOWN
In my experience they are very kind to my dog who although small he isn’t easy to handle. He used to fight off groomers but always goes right into this place no troubles getting him through the door.
Took real good care while trimming my dog's mane

They are starting to care less and do less, not a good job at all!!! My first few times here was great but now my poodle still stinks when leaving and his hair cut is horrible. They are not listening to the customer's concerns, and my dog is looking and smelling as though he didn't even get groomed!! Its horrible to pay for a service that you are not receiving properly. I'm not coming back to spend my hard earned money with Aleman's anymore!! They barely washed my dog. The cut looks butchered and his face shape is not what I asked for. The groomer, she just literally does what she want, and I'm not paying for this anymore. This is the third attempt after I've expressed my concern and still they are not caring and they are presenting me with a stinky ungroomed dog! He is usually a very pretty poodle mix and they are not taking the time to do the job. I won't be back, their services are lacking and I can see this place is starting to care less and it will be going downhill soon. It's a shame because the girl at the front desk is really sweet but the new groomer or the lady groomer is not taking her time, not properly washing the dogs and not doing good cuts. Im not sure what they changed but its not for the good. Aleman's grooming count your days!!!!

This was a terrible experience. How could they leave a Pomeranian like that? It could cause alopecia. I don't recommend this dog groomer. They're not professionals because they should know how to care for a Pomeranian's coat. Now I'm worried. I hope my dog ​​doesn't get alopecia.

I've gone to several different dog groomers but Aleman's has been my favorite! Their prices are reasonable, they're great with my dogs,  and the staff has always been helpful and friendly. My oldest dog has anxiety with groomers and she honestly has done the best here. I recommend them to everyone.

I LOVE this place. My dog ​​Princessa always comes out looking so cute! The staff is always so welcoming and nice. Everyone is super professional. I drive an hour for my dog ​​to get a haircut here. 100% recommend!

I definitely recommend coming here to get your pets' haircuts. Everyone is very kind and respectful. They treat your pet with love and care. Super cute haircuts, and they always listen to what you want.
Great place to take your dog!!👍 …
Best please on Chicago to take care of your dog, professional and caring!
I love this place. They do a great job with cleaning my dog, the ladies were super nice and friendly.
